title: The Flood Begins

questions.question: How long did the rain fall during the flood?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:12: Rain fell upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

questions.question: Who shut the door of the ark?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:16: "And the LORD shut him in."

questions.question: What happened to all creatures outside the ark?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:21-23: All flesh with the breath of life died; only Noah and those with him survived.

questions.question: Did the waters cover the mountains?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:19: "all the high mountains under the whole heaven were covered."

questions.question: How many of each unclean animal went on the ark?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:2: Unclean animals came in pairs, clean animals in sevens.

questions.question: How many pairs of clean animals did Noah take?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:2: "Take with you seven pairs of all clean animals."

questions.question: How many days passed between Noah entering the ark and the rain starting?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:4,10: God gave 7 days notice before sending rain.

questions.question: How deep did the waters rise above the mountains?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:20: Waters covered the mountains by fifteen cubits.

questions.question: How long did the waters prevail upon the earth?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:24: "the waters prevailed on the earth 150 days."

questions.question: What two sources did the flood waters come from?
options: Fountains of the deep and windows of heaven
questions.correctAnswer: Fountains of the deep and windows of heaven
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:11: Fountains of the great deep burst forth and windows of heaven opened.

questions.question: How old was Noah when the flood came?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:6: Noah was 600 years old when the flood waters came.

questions.question: In what month and day did the flood begin?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:11: "In the 600th year... second month, seventeenth day."

questions.question: According to Genesis 7:15, how many of each kind came to Noah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:15: "They went into the ark with Noah, two and two of all flesh."

questions.question: What phrase describes how the animals came to the ark?
options: They were scared by the storm
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:9,15: The animals came to Noah and entered the ark themselves.

questions.question: What happened to the ark when the waters rose?
options: It rose high above the earth
questions.correctAnswer: It rose high above the earth
questions.explanation: Genesis 7:17: "the ark rose high above the earth."

key_verse_text: And the LORD shut him in.
